info.title: Nexo Pro API

get.description:
Retrieves a list of available assets and their corresponding balances.
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

get.description:
Returns information about the current fee tiers of the user.
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

get.summary: Get a list of all pairs, min and max amounts.
get.description:
Returns a list of all pairs that can be traded on Nexo Pro, along with the minimum and maximum amounts that can be traded per trade. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

200.description: List of pairs, min and max limits.

get.description:
Get an approximate current price for the provided pair, side and amount. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: The side for the quote buy or sell. (Case sensitive)

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: The exchanges for the quote, comma seperated list, if omitted quote will be returned for all supported exchanges.

post.description:
Places an order and instantly returns the id, as execution against exchanges is asynchronous. Use the id to get more specific information via /api/v1/orderDetails endpoint. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

500.description: No orders found for the requested pairs in the specified time frame.

get.description:
Retrieves order history for a selected pair or list of pairs, in a specific timeframe. Supports pagination for ease of use. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

parameters.name: pairs
parameters.description: List of pairs to get orders from

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Milliseconds timestamp for beginning of search period.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Milliseconds timestamp for end of search period.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size of search result. Maximum accepted value is 50.

200.description: The orders executed in the given time frame.

500.description: No orders found for the requested pairs in the specified time frame.

value.errorMessage: Deal with the specified id cannot be found.

post.description:

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

parameters.name: X-NONCE

get.description:
Provide metadata information for spot order. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

parameters.name: pairs
parameters.description: Specific pair/s that can be traded on Nexo Prime. Example: BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT /comma separated list/. If pair/s are not passed return all available pairs. (Case sensitive)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size of search result. Maximum accepted value is 50.

parameters.description: Milliseconds timestamp for end of search period.

Type value is invalid.summary: Value of field type is not valid

get.description:
Retrieves all currently available futures instruments along with their precisions. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

get.description:
Retrieves futures positions. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the desired positions. If not passed filter "any" is applied. (Case sensitive)

post.description:
Places a futures order and returns its id. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

post.description:
Closes all active positions and returns positions to close count. 
 
 Roles allowed: TRADER, VIEWER

parameters.name: X-NONCE
parameters.description: The millisecond timestamp of request creation.

min_limits.description: Map of asset and min limit.

max_limits.description: Map of asset and max limit.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of quote in UTC.

side.description: The side for the order buy or sell. (Case sensitive)
The side for the order buy or sell. (Case sensitive)
The side for the order buy or sell. (Case sensitive)

asset.description: The asset to be moved. (Case sensitive)

lockedBalance.description: Amount locked in futures, limit orders and etc.

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last balance operation.
Date of the last balance operation.

id.description: The order ID in the form "\<number\>_\<number\>"

feeAsset.description: The asset of the trading fee

filledSplits.description: The number of filled TWAP splits.

totalSplits.description: The number of total TWAP splits.

exchanges.description: List of exchanges, against which to execute the deal.

splits.description: The number of the trades to split the TWAP to.

executionInterval.description: Execution interval in seconds. Accepts 10, 20 or 30.

twapDurationMinutes.description: TWAP minutes duration. Should be used in combination with twapDurationHours.

positionAction.description: The position action - open or close. (Case sensitive)

positionSide.description: The side for the order - long or short. (Case sensitive)

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error message explaining which is the missing param.
